name: Model retries per day
description:
Shows: Failed model requests the fallback logic counted (throttled, stall, server_error, transport_error, daily_quota), per day, agent and model. Reads the factory.model_retry span event.
Why it matters: Retries add latency and eat into the call budget. The reason split separates provider problems (server_error, stall) from our own pressure on rate limits (throttled, daily_quota).
